quality_assessment: Well-structured and accurate documentation with clear examples. Missing some granular filtering flags and custom type definition details.

issues.description: Missing documentation for granular ignore control flags
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a subsection documenting --no-ignore, --no-ignore-vcs, --no-ignore-global, --no-ignore-dot, and --no-ignore-parent (which is documented under Advanced Filtering, but should be cross-referenced here for completeness)

issues.description: Missing documentation for --type-add flag to define custom file types
issues.fix_suggestion: Add example showing how to define custom file types with --type-add, such as: rg --type-add 'web:*.{html,css,js}' -tweb pattern

issues.description: Potential flag name discrepancy for filesystem boundary flag
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify that --same-file-system is the correct flag name. Features.json refers to --one-file-system. If both exist, document both; if one is an alias, clarify.
Add documentation for --max-columns (if different from --max-columns-preview) or clarify that --max-columns-preview is the correct flag name
Add brief explanation of remaining glob syntax elements like ? (single char) and [...] (character class). Example: rg -g 'test?.rs' or rg -g 'file[0-9].txt'

issues.description: Custom type definition in config file mentioned but not explained
issues.fix_suggestion: Either add a brief inline example or add a clearer cross-reference to the configuration file documentation showing how to define custom types

positive_aspects: Clear, logical organization of file filtering topics
Excellent progression from simple to advanced filtering
Multiple practical examples for each flag
Accurate documentation of glob patterns with negation
Clear descriptions of default behavior vs. override flags
Good use of code blocks for examples
improvement_suggestions: Add a comparison table showing when to use -t/--type vs -g/--glob vs -u flags
Include a troubleshooting section for common filtering issues (e.g., 'Why isn't my file being searched?')
Add cross-reference to performance page for --max-filesize impact on search speed
Consider adding a 'Quick Reference' section at the top with most common filtering flags
Add visual indicators (like MkDocs admonitions) for important notes about default behavior
